newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi stocks marginally up on fund buying.
newsitem.headline: Delhi stocks marginally up on fund buying.

text.p: Delhi stocks quoted marginally higher on Friday in afternoon trade on selective purchases by foreign institutional investors (FIIs) and speculators, brokers said.
FIIs, which stayed on the sidelines in early trade, made some purchases in ITC, State Bank of India and a few other key stocks banking on an improvement in demand, they said.
By 12.45 p.m. (0715 GMT), the sensitive index recovered 0.10 point to 796.10 after dropping to 794.59 in early trade.

"The shares have been showing narrow movements as major players were not interested in creating fresh positions as today is the last day of the current settlement," Suresh Aggarwal of brokers Jaimata Securities said.
Reliance edged up 1.0 rupee to 296.65 rupees on emergence of low-level buying, brokers said.
MTNL rose 2.0 rupees at 291.0 on FII buying while State Bank of India was up 2.0 rupees to 310.0, brokers said.
